```{r}
#| label: prepare-explore-data
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(jsonlite)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Load each survey in an isolated environment so that the same
# load_data.R / build_explore_data.R pipeline can be reused.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

load_explore_survey <- function(survey_id) {

  env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
  env$survey_selected <- survey_id

  sys.source(
    here("R", "load_data.R"),
    envir = env
  )

  sys.source(
    here("R", "build_explore_data.R"),
    envir = env
  )

  list(
    station_summary = env$explore_station_summary,
    station_species = env$explore_station_species,
    records = env$explore_records
  )
}

survey_ids <- c(
  "W8_2024",
  "CR_2025"
)

explore_list <- setNames(
  lapply(survey_ids, load_explore_survey),
  survey_ids
)

station_summary_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    explore_list,
    `[[`,
    "station_summary"
  )
)

station_species_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    explore_list,
    `[[`,
    "station_species"
  )
)

records_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    explore_list,
    `[[`,
    "records"
  )
)

# Survey labels
survey_metadata <- read_csv(
  here("data", "metadata", "surveys.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(survey_id %in% survey_ids) |>
  transmute(
    survey_id,
    survey_label = paste0(
      site_name,
      " — ",
      year
    )
  )

# Species metadata
species_metadata <- read_csv(
  here(
    "data",
    "metadata",
    "species_metadata.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Survey-period contextual summaries for the cards
# ------------------------------------------------------------

richness_context <- records_all |>
  left_join(
    species_metadata,
    by = "Species"
  ) |>
  filter(include_in_richness %in% TRUE) |>
  distinct(
    survey_id,
    period,
    Species_display
  ) |>
  count(
    survey_id,
    period,
    name = "observed_species"
  )

context_summary <- station_summary_all |>
  group_by(
    survey_id,
    period
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_stations = n_distinct(Station),
    n_mapped_stations = sum(
      coordinate_available,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    total_trap_nights = sum(
      trap_nights,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    total_independent_events = sum(
      independent_events,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    richness_context,
    by = c(
      "survey_id",
      "period"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    observed_species = replace_na(
      observed_species,
      0L
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build one long table for all map metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

station_base <- station_summary_all |>
  select(
    survey_id,
    period,
    Station,
    treatment,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    coordinate_available,
    trap_nights,
    independent_events,
    events_per_100_trap_nights,
    observed_species_richness
  )

map_effort <- station_base |>
  transmute(
    survey_id,
    period,
    Station,
    treatment,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    coordinate_available,
    species = "All species",
    metric = "effort",
    metric_label = "Active trap-nights",
    value = trap_nights,
    trap_nights,
    independent_events,
    station_richness = observed_species_richness
  )

map_events_all <- station_base |>
  transmute(
    survey_id,
    period,
    Station,
    treatment,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    coordinate_available,
    species = "All species",
    metric = "events",
    metric_label = "Independent events",
    value = as.numeric(independent_events),
    trap_nights,
    independent_events,
    station_richness = observed_species_richness
  )

map_rate_all <- station_base |>
  transmute(
    survey_id,
    period,
    Station,
    treatment,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    coordinate_available,
    species = "All species",
    metric = "rate",
    metric_label = "Events / 100 trap-nights",
    value = events_per_100_trap_nights,
    trap_nights,
    independent_events,
    station_richness = observed_species_richness
  )

map_richness <- station_base |>
  transmute(
    survey_id,
    period,
    Station,
    treatment,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    coordinate_available,
    species = "All species",
    metric = "richness",
    metric_label = "Observed species richness",
    value = as.numeric(observed_species_richness),
    trap_nights,
    independent_events,
    station_richness = observed_species_richness
  )

species_rows <- station_species_all |>
  mutate(
    species = coalesce(
      Species_display,
      Species
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    station_summary_all |>
      select(
        survey_id,
        period,
        Station,
        station_richness =
          observed_species_richness
      ),
    by = c(
      "survey_id",
      "period",
      "Station"
    )
  )

map_events_species <- species_rows |>
  transmute(
    survey_id,
    period,
    Station,
    treatment,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    coordinate_available,
    species,
    metric = "events",
    metric_label = "Independent events",
    value = as.numeric(independent_events),
    trap_nights,
    independent_events,
    station_richness
  )

map_rate_species <- species_rows |>
  transmute(
    survey_id,
    period,
    Station,
    treatment,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    coordinate_available,
    species,
    metric = "rate",
    metric_label = "Events / 100 trap-nights",
    value = events_per_100_trap_nights,
    trap_nights,
    independent_events,
    station_richness
  )

map_data <- bind_rows(
  map_effort,
  map_events_all,
  map_rate_all,
  map_richness,
  map_events_species,
  map_rate_species
) |>
  left_join(
    survey_metadata,
    by = "survey_id"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    survey_id,
    period,
    metric,
    species,
    Station
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Species list by survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------

species_options <- station_species_all |>
  mutate(
    species = coalesce(
      Species_display,
      Species
    )
  ) |>
  distinct(
    survey_id,
    species
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(species),
    species != ""
  ) |>
  arrange(
    survey_id,
    species
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert objects to JSON for the browser
# ------------------------------------------------------------

map_json <- toJSON(
  map_data,
  dataframe = "rows",
  na = "null",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

context_json <- toJSON(
  context_summary |>
    left_join(
      survey_metadata,
      by = "survey_id"
    ),
  dataframe = "rows",
  na = "null",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

species_json <- toJSON(
  species_options,
  dataframe = "rows",
  na = "null",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

survey_json <- toJSON(
  survey_metadata,
  dataframe = "rows",
  na = "null",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

# Prevent accidental closing of script tag
map_json <- gsub(
  "</",
  "<\\/",
  map_json,
  fixed = TRUE
)

context_json <- gsub(
  "</",
  "<\\/",
  context_json,
  fixed = TRUE
)

species_json <- gsub(
  "</",
  "<\\/",
  species_json,
  fixed = TRUE
)

survey_json <- gsub(
  "</",
  "<\\/",
  survey_json,
  fixed = TRUE
)
```

::: {.callout-note}
### Interpreting the explorer

The **30-day bait experiment** uses the first 30 days after deployment
at each station and is the appropriate period for questions focused on
attractant treatments. The **full survey** uses all available sampling
effort and records.

`Events / 100 trap-nights` standardizes independent records by sampling
effort. Observed species richness includes only categories identified as
wildlife species in the project species metadata.
:::

```{r}
#| label: inject-explore-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

cat(
  "<script>\n",
  "const exploreMapData = ", map_json, ";\n",
  "const exploreContext = ", context_json, ";\n",
  "const exploreSpecies = ", species_json, ";\n",
  "const exploreSurveys = ", survey_json, ";\n",
  "</script>\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {

  const surveySelect =
    document.getElementById("explore-survey");

  const periodSelect =
    document.getElementById("explore-period");

  const metricSelect =
    document.getElementById("explore-metric");

  const speciesSelect =
    document.getElementById("explore-species");

  const mapNote =
    document.getElementById("explore-map-note");

  const tableBody =
    document.getElementById("explore-table-body");

  const metricTableHeading =
    document.getElementById("metric-table-heading");

  const stationStat =
    document.getElementById("stat-stations");

  const effortStat =
    document.getElementById("stat-effort");

  const eventStat =
    document.getElementById("stat-events");

  const richnessStat =
    document.getElementById("stat-richness");


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Populate survey selector
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  exploreSurveys.forEach(function (d) {

    const option =
      document.createElement("option");

    option.value = d.survey_id;
    option.textContent = d.survey_label;

    surveySelect.appendChild(option);

  });


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Leaflet map
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const map = L.map(
    "explore-map",
    {
      zoomControl: true
    }
  );

  const satellite = L.tileLayer(
    "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/" +
    "World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    {
      attribution:
        "Tiles © Esri"
    }
  );

  const streets = L.tileLayer(
    "https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",
    {
      attribution:
        "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
    }
  );

  satellite.addTo(map);

  L.control.layers(
    {
      "Satellite": satellite,
      "Street map": streets
    },
    null,
    {
      collapsed: true
    }
  ).addTo(map);

  let markerLayer =
    L.layerGroup().addTo(map);


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Helpers
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const treatmentColors = {
    "Control": "#2f6fb0",
    "Fish bait": "#c25c08",
    "Perfume": "#5d3291",
    "Other": "#6b7280"
  };

  function formatNumber(value, digits) {

    if (
      value === null ||
      value === undefined ||
      Number.isNaN(Number(value))
    ) {
      return "—";
    }

    return Number(value).toLocaleString(
      undefined,
      {
        minimumFractionDigits: digits,
        maximumFractionDigits: digits
      }
    );

  }

  function metricDigits(metric) {

    if (
      metric === "rate" ||
      metric === "effort"
    ) {
      return 1;
    }

    return 0;

  }

  function metricLabel(metric) {

    const labels = {
      effort: "Active trap-nights",
      events: "Independent events",
      rate: "Events / 100 trap-nights",
      richness: "Observed species richness"
    };

    return labels[metric];

  }

  function metricUsesSpecies(metric) {

    return (
      metric === "events" ||
      metric === "rate"
    );

  }


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Species selector
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  function updateSpeciesOptions() {

    const survey =
      surveySelect.value;

    const metric =
      metricSelect.value;

    const previous =
      speciesSelect.value;

    speciesSelect.innerHTML = "";

    const allOption =
      document.createElement("option");

    allOption.value = "All species";
    allOption.textContent = "All species";

    speciesSelect.appendChild(allOption);

    if (metricUsesSpecies(metric)) {

      const names = exploreSpecies
        .filter(function (d) {
          return d.survey_id === survey;
        })
        .map(function (d) {
          return d.species;
        });

      [...new Set(names)]
        .sort(function (a, b) {
          return a.localeCompare(b);
        })
        .forEach(function (name) {

          const option =
            document.createElement("option");

          option.value = name;
          option.textContent = name;

          speciesSelect.appendChild(option);

        });

      speciesSelect.disabled = false;

      const available =
        [...speciesSelect.options]
          .some(function (o) {
            return o.value === previous;
          });

      speciesSelect.value =
        available
          ? previous
          : "All species";

    } else {

      speciesSelect.value =
        "All species";

      speciesSelect.disabled = true;

    }

  }


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Filter current map data
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  function currentRows() {

    const survey =
      surveySelect.value;

    const period =
      periodSelect.value;

    const metric =
      metricSelect.value;

    const species =
      metricUsesSpecies(metric)
        ? speciesSelect.value
        : "All species";

    return exploreMapData.filter(
      function (d) {

        return (
          d.survey_id === survey &&
          d.period === period &&
          d.metric === metric &&
          d.species === species
        );

      }
    );

  }


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Context cards
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  function updateCards(rows) {

    const survey =
      surveySelect.value;

    const period =
      periodSelect.value;

    const species =
      speciesSelect.value;

    const metric =
      metricSelect.value;

    const context =
      exploreContext.find(
        function (d) {
          return (
            d.survey_id === survey &&
            d.period === period
          );
        }
      );

    if (!context) {
      return;
    }

    stationStat.textContent =
      context.n_mapped_stations ===
      context.n_stations
        ? formatNumber(
            context.n_stations,
            0
          )
        : (
            formatNumber(
              context.n_mapped_stations,
              0
            ) +
            " / " +
            formatNumber(
              context.n_stations,
              0
            )
          );

    effortStat.textContent =
      formatNumber(
        context.total_trap_nights,
        1
      );

    if (
      metricUsesSpecies(metric) &&
      species !== "All species"
    ) {

      const selectedEvents =
        rows.reduce(
          function (total, d) {
            return total +
              Number(
                d.independent_events || 0
              );
          },
          0
        );

      eventStat.textContent =
        formatNumber(
          selectedEvents,
          0
        );

    } else {

      eventStat.textContent =
        formatNumber(
          context.total_independent_events,
          0
        );

    }

    richnessStat.textContent =
      formatNumber(
        context.observed_species,
        0
      );

  }


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Marker size
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  function markerRadius(
    value,
    maxValue
  ) {

    const x =
      Number(value);

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(x) ||
      x <= 0
    ) {
      return 5;
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(maxValue) ||
      maxValue <= 0
    ) {
      return 7;
    }

    return (
      6 +
      14 *
      Math.sqrt(x / maxValue)
    );

  }


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Update map
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  function updateMap(rows) {

    markerLayer.clearLayers();

    const mappedRows =
      rows.filter(
        function (d) {

          return (
            d.coordinate_available === true &&
            d.latitude !== null &&
            d.longitude !== null
          );

        }
      );

    const maxValue =
      Math.max(
        0,
        ...mappedRows
          .map(function (d) {
            return Number(d.value);
          })
          .filter(Number.isFinite)
      );

    const bounds = [];

    mappedRows.forEach(
      function (d) {

        const color =
          treatmentColors[d.treatment] ||
          treatmentColors.Other;

        const radius =
          markerRadius(
            d.value,
            maxValue
          );

        const digits =
          metricDigits(d.metric);

        let popup =
          "<strong>" +
          d.Station +
          "</strong><br>" +
          d.treatment +
          "<br><br>";

        if (
          metricUsesSpecies(d.metric) &&
          d.species !== "All species"
        ) {

          popup +=
            "<strong>Species:</strong> " +
            d.species +
            "<br>";

        }

        popup +=
          "<strong>" +
          d.metric_label +
          ":</strong> " +
          formatNumber(
            d.value,
            digits
          ) +
          "<br>" +
          "<strong>Trap-nights:</strong> " +
          formatNumber(
            d.trap_nights,
            1
          );

        const marker =
          L.circleMarker(
            [
              Number(d.latitude),
              Number(d.longitude)
            ],
            {
              radius: radius,
              color: color,
              weight: 2,
              fillColor: color,
              fillOpacity:
                Number(d.value) > 0
                  ? 0.72
                  : 0.12
            }
          )
          .bindPopup(popup)
          .bindTooltip(
            d.Station +
            ": " +
            formatNumber(
              d.value,
              digits
            )
          );

        marker.addTo(markerLayer);

        bounds.push(
          [
            Number(d.latitude),
            Number(d.longitude)
          ]
        );

      }
    );

    if (bounds.length > 0) {

      map.fitBounds(
        bounds,
        {
          padding: [35, 35],
          maxZoom: 15
        }
      );

    }

    const missing =
      rows.length -
      mappedRows.length;

    if (missing > 0) {

      mapNote.textContent =
        missing +
        (
          missing === 1
            ? " station is "
            : " stations are "
        ) +
        "included in the summaries but cannot currently be shown on the map because coordinates are unavailable.";

    } else {

      mapNote.textContent = "";

    }

  }


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Station table
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  function updateTable(rows) {

    tableBody.innerHTML = "";

    const metric =
      metricSelect.value;

    metricTableHeading.textContent =
      metricLabel(metric);

    const sorted =
      [...rows].sort(
        function (a, b) {
          return a.Station.localeCompare(
            b.Station,
            undefined,
            {
              numeric: true
            }
          );
        }
      );

    sorted.forEach(
      function (d) {

        const tr =
          document.createElement("tr");

        const values = [
          d.Station,
          d.treatment,
          formatNumber(
            d.trap_nights,
            1
          ),
          formatNumber(
            d.value,
            metricDigits(metric)
          )
        ];

        values.forEach(
          function (value) {

            const td =
              document.createElement("td");

            td.textContent = value;

            tr.appendChild(td);

          }
        );

        tableBody.appendChild(tr);

      }
    );

  }


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Master refresh
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  function refresh() {

    const rows =
      currentRows();

    updateCards(rows);
    updateMap(rows);
    updateTable(rows);

  }


  surveySelect.addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
      updateSpeciesOptions();
      refresh();
    }
  );

  periodSelect.addEventListener(
    "change",
    refresh
  );

  metricSelect.addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
      updateSpeciesOptions();
      refresh();
    }
  );

  speciesSelect.addEventListener(
    "change",
    refresh
  );


  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Initial state
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    [...surveySelect.options]
      .some(function (o) {
        return o.value === "W8_2024";
      })
  ) {
    surveySelect.value =
      "W8_2024";
  }

  periodSelect.value =
    "30-day bait experiment";

  metricSelect.value =
    "events";

  updateSpeciesOptions();
  refresh();

})();
</script>
```
